segments.text: As you can see, the image above, the 2 gels which have gone to the homogenization step are significantly larger, up to 2 to 3 times larger than the gels that have not been homogenized.
So we might get different expansion sizes that may differ from 4 x or 11 x with the homogenized hydrogels versus the non-homogenized hydrogels.
